faqs.a:
In the event of a change in managers, pawnbroker shall disclose to city said change
               within 30 days of change, and the new manager shall be photographed and fingerprinted
               by the city police department. Pawnbroker shall furnish three reference letters for
               new manager, and the new manager shall be investigated pursuant to
section 22-203
. Pawnbroker shall pay a nonrefundable investigation fee of $500.00 for the investigation
               of a new manager. Failure of a new manager to meet the prescribed standards and qualifications
               shall constitute grounds for denial, suspension, cancellation or revocation of the
               license.
(Code 1981, § 23-9; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
